hero.title: About Data Center Valley
hero.lead: Building the foundational infrastructure for the next generation of global computing.

why.label: Why Data Center Valley
why.disclaimer: Final technical and commercial parameters are subject to project documentation and regulatory approvals.
why.textMuted: Data Center Valley is established with a clear and ambitious mission: to build a sovereign yet globally integrated artificial intelligence infrastructure hub.
why.textStrong: By strategic positioning in one of the region’s most vital energy clusters, we convert abundant power and vast territory into secure, scalable, and highly efficient compute capacity tailored specifically for the global AI economy.

geo.title:
Strategic Geography
& Corridor
geo.text: Positioned at the critical crossroads between Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, Kazakhstan is rapidly gaining immense relevance as a premier digital and logistics corridor. Data Center Valley capitalizes on this unique geographical advantage, offering hyperscalers and international enterprises an ultra-connected infrastructure node that seamlessly bridges major global markets with low-latency data pathways.
geo.mapAlt: Latency map connecting Data Center Valley to major European and Central Asian hubs

accordion.title: Заголовок
accordion.text: Data Center Valley operates in full coordination with national infrastructure planning bodies, ensuring predictable long-term access to power, land and network resources.

accordion.title: Заголовок
accordion.text: The development of Data Center Valley is fully aligned with national digital transformation priorities and strategic investment frameworks. Backed by comprehensive infrastructure coordination at the highest state level, the platform ensures long-term regulatory predictability, robust investment protection, and a streamlined operational environment for our global partners and institutional investors.

accordion.title: Заголовок
accordion.text: Investment protection is reinforced through established legal frameworks, offering international partners clarity and confidence in long-horizon infrastructure commitments.

accordion.title: Заголовок
accordion.text: A dedicated coordination framework streamlines permitting, utility connections and regulatory approvals across all phases of campus development.

accordion.title: Заголовок
accordion.text: Ongoing collaboration with national institutions supports workforce development and integration with the broader digital economy.

hero.title: Our Services
hero.lead: From fast deployment in prepared capacity to large-scale greenfield development and AI compute partnerships

cards.title: Wholesale Colocation
cards.text: Fast access to power, cooling and secure data center capacity for cloud providers, AI companies and GPU operators. Our wholesale colocation solutions offer rapidly deployable environments engineered to support high-density racks and advanced cooling methodologies required for modern AI workloads.

cards.title: Build-to-Suit
cards.text: Dedicated infrastructure built to specific technical and operational requirements for hyperscalers and sovereign AI platforms. We collaborate closely with your engineering teams to design, construct, and deliver custom data center facilities optimized for your unique hardware architecture, redundancy specifications, and efficiency goals.

cards.title: Greenfield Development
cards.text: Land, power, utilities and network access for large technology companies seeking direct development control. Access pre-identified and permitted land parcels within our ecosystem, complete with high-voltage power connections and established fiber routes, allowing you to execute large-scale construction under your proprietary blueprints.

cards.title: AI Compute Partnerships
cards.text: Participation in the AI compute value chain for GPU-as-a-Service platforms and institutional investors. Beyond physical space, Data Center Valley acts as an ecosystem enabler, offering joint-venture models and strategic frameworks to deploy turn-key high-performance computing clusters geared for global AI demand.

cta.title:
Deploy Your Infrastructure
at Giga-Scale
cta.text: Our team is ready to analyze your technical requirements and prepare a tailored briefing.

hero.lead: Engineered from the ground up to convert unprecedented power and territory into seamless compute capacity
